definitions.explanation: Very polite honorific term for someone else's father, or a formal address used by a child to their own father in upper-class or traditional families. More formal than お{父|とう}さん.

examples.japanese: お{父様|とうさま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
お{父様|とうさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your father.

examples.japanese: お{父様|とうさま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧そうです⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I hear your father runs a company.

notes:
Highly polite term formed with the honorific prefix お and the honorific suffix ⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧. Used primarily when referring respectfully to the listener's or a third party's father; rare in casual speech.

POLITENESS HIERARCHY (from casual to formal):
- ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧: my father — humble; for one's own father when talking to outsiders
- ⟦パパ→パパ：01788_papa⟧ / お{父|とう}ちゃん: dad / papa — casual, often childlike
- ⟦お{父|とう}さん→お父さん：02855_otousan⟧: father — standard polite
- お{父様|とうさま}: father — very polite/formal, often for someone else's father

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{父様|とうさま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: please tell your father
- お{父様|とうさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: your father's work
- ご{両親様|りょうしんさま}・お{父様|とうさま}・お{母様|かあさま}: standard formal trio in letters and invitations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{母様|かあさま}: mother (very polite) — parallel form
- ご{尊父|そんぷ}: your honorable father — used in formal letters and condolences
